gitCommit.subject: feat(portal): business sign-up on the web at /signup (App Store guideline 3.1.1)
gitCommit.body:
feat(portal): business sign-up on the web at /signup (App Store guideline 3.1.1)

Apple refused iOS 1.0 because the app registers businesses; the owner chose to move sign-up to the web (2026-11-15).
The portal now publishes the existing application at /signup, linked from its sign-in. The page asks for the
WhatsApp consent the server requires (the server's copy, its version sent back; an updated copy is shown again,
unticked), sends the first code as the verification step opens, and ends saying the 7-day free trial has started
and to sign in to the app.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
